proof_scope: Fixed-data polynomial section bound, smooth positive leading Bergman density, uniform point/jet projective embedding, elementary smooth hyperplane divisor, fixed-twist nef section asymptotic on manifolds carrying a positive bundle. Specified global analytic type resolves to bounded residual nef class; rational exceptional correction establishes a positive bundle upstairs. Arbitrary strictly positive psh metrics have exact multiplier-volume section asymptotics by gentle approximation, model extrapolation plus a strict minorant, compact point extension and local integrability-to-growth. General nonstrict compact Kahler metrics and positive-mass bigness are not inferred.
